note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'Ryan Giggs' / 'pounces' (the interception) through each defender's name to 'he scores' (the ball in the roof of the net): keep the pause at '...'. Chapter 2 pans fast down the pitch on 'At full speed'; 'out, in, out' each paint one change of direction.

chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Villa Park, 1999, extra time. Ryan Giggs pounces on a loose pass in his own half. Past Vieira, past Dixon twice, past Keown, past Adams... he scores!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Close touches keep the ball tight to his left foot. At full speed he changes direction: out, in, out! Defenders can't keep up.

chapters.label: Into the roof
chapters.text: From a tight angle, he lashes it high over David Seaman, into the roof of the net!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: dribble with close touches, change direction at speed, and when the keeper goes down, finish high!
